segments.line: We'll take that," he says. " And you'll come with us. Just for a few questions." A few questions. You
know what that means. You're the
only person on Earth who can make money, cars and energy out of nothing.
Nobody is letting you go home.
Mum steps between you and the man. " He's fourteen," she says. " He's not going anywhere."
Two more men get out of the cars.
Ellie is on the stairs in her pajamas. She's crying. You can't
run. And invincible doesn't help when the problem isn't hurting you. It's taking you. You
could make a hundred bags of money, or a hundred cars.
Nothing on that list makes people forget. So you
grab the controller, run up to your room and
lock the door. You
pull out the list and press it flat against the window. And with the
evening sun shining through the paper, you can finally read the word under the scribbles.
Reset.
Downstairs, the front door opens. Footsteps on the stairs. "
Don't do anything stupid," the man says through the door. Ellie says your name. Your
phone buzzes again. Mo. " Whatever you're about to do, don't." You don't
know what reset means. Reset the
cheats? Reset the
house? Reset
you?
But it's the only code left that might fix everything. So you
enter it. Red. Red. Down. Blue. Up.
